description.value:
Rank 1 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 6 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Weapon's Range
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

Raise your weapon high above your head for an empowered attack. Roll a Combo Attack Roll dealing your Weapon Damage Die + 1d6 Weapon Damage on a hit.

This Attack Roll is a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Melee Weapon* that you are proficient with.
